notes: Correctly preserves the verdicts, scope caveats, uncertainty, and actionable investigation steps.

defects.quote: a missing policy is not a pass
defects.why: NO_POLICY establishes no applicable evaluated SLA rule for the window, not that a policy is missing from the configuration.

defects.quote: a minor internal inconsistency in the derived rate
defects.why: The throughput denominator and sample count are different quantities, so their difference is not an internal inconsistency.

notes: Useful investigation guidance is weakened by unsupported claims about policy configuration and metric consistency.

defects.quote: the window totals add to the overall 5320/52000
defects.why: It equates policy-window aggregates with a whole-run aggregate even though they are different windowed quantities.

defects.quote: There is no resource acceptance policy in this run
defects.why: NO_POLICY does not prove that no resource policy was configured; it only establishes that no applicable SLA resource rule was evaluated for the result.

notes: The error investigation recommendations are useful, but the response omits the required coverage fact and makes unsupported scope and policy claims.

defects.quote: The cause therefore lies in sampler/application errors rather than latency or resource policy.
defects.why: The evidence shows that the error-rate rule caused the verdict but does not establish the root cause of the errors or exclude a latency-related contribution.

notes: It is otherwise accurate and operationally useful, but overstates an unproven root-cause conclusion.
